Name: JP's Farms - Four Wonders Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
﻿
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u]Four Wonders Farm[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[i][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Stardew Valley is broken, grandpa sure did some weird things with the farm...[/size][/color][/b][/i]
[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A farm divided into 4 maps, each with a different theme.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A rainforest, it rains every day and some harvestable mushrooms grow.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A forest of eternal sun, it is always daytime and grows a large amount of harvestables.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A farm where it is always at night, there are many monsters and yet it is the best place to raise animals and get truffles. (During the day you will not be able to see anything but at night, when the moon rises, you will be able to see a little more although it is always good to have some torches.)[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A farm where the day lasts much longer.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i][color=#ff7700]Original size of the Standard Farm (80x65) >>> Each of these farms (80x100) + Cliffs removed for more space in general.[/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[youtube]t9gsMoCUSIg[/youtube]

[i][color=#ff0000][size=5]It's a pretty compressed summary but this way you will have more to discover, hope you enjoy it![/size][/color][/i]

[/font]
[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color]
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]

[/font][/b]
